description: Convert internationalised domain names to and from Punycode (RFC 3492): bücher.example ⇄ xn--bcher-kva.example. Operations: "to-ascii" — Encode each Unicode label as an xn-- label (one domain, email or URL per line; labels are NFC-normalised and lowercased).; "to-unicode" — Decode each xn-- label back to Unicode (one domain, email or URL per line).; "encode" — Encode one string with the bare RFC 3492 algorithm (no xn-- prefix, case kept).; "decode" — Decode one bare Punycode string (no xn-- prefix) with the RFC 3492 algorithm.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: to-ascii: Domain names, email addresses or URLs, one per line. to-unicode: Domain names, email addresses or URLs with xn-- labels, one per line. encode: The Unicode string to encode. decode: The Punycode string to decode.

operation.description: to-ascii — Encode each Unicode label as an xn-- label (one domain, email or URL per line; labels are NFC-normalised and lowercased). to-unicode — Decode each xn-- label back to Unicode (one domain, email or URL per line). encode — Encode one string with the bare RFC 3492 algorithm (no xn-- prefix, case kept). decode — Decode one bare Punycode string (no xn-- prefix) with the RFC 3492 algorithm.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

name: punycode
title: Punycode & IDN Converter
